_reviews_note: No review fields in this example, by design. Do not write, paraphrase or place-hold a customer quote. A human either pastes verbatim review text copied from the client's live Google listing (reviewer name exactly as it appears there) and sets REVIEW_n_SOURCE to that listing URL, or deletes the reviews section from index.html. Any REVIEW_n_TEXT/REVIEW_n_NAME without a matching https REVIEW_n_SOURCE fails `npm run starter:check-reviews`.
